title: ID0468038-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197001] HMI issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:

Solution: Possible replace HMI

additional_info.subject: Abertura de chamado - Shell Recharge l Posto Rosim ( Y2 R4 313020197001 )
additional_info.body:
Boa tarde, prezados.
Espero que todos estejam bem!
@Albino, Andre Sousa
, como falamos, estamos com uma falha na IHM da estação Shell Recharge l Posto Rosim -
ROD. Anhaguera, 207 - Vila Belmiro, Pirassununga - SP - 13633-480. Inicialmente a IHM parecia estar totalmente escura mas analisando as filmagens no CFTV do local é possível ver que a tela está muito escura podendo estar apresentado algum tipo de falha no brilho, em anexo está um print que tirei de madrugada onde é possível verificar melhor as condições de funcionamento,  junto com um print da estação HD PARK para termos como
exemplo
o brilho da tela. Poderia por gentileza efetuar uma abertura de chamado para efetuar o reparo neste local?
Att.

additional_info.subject: ID0468038-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197001] HMI issue CRM:03209000027
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0468038
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-BR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: GodEnergi A/S
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / R3 313020197001
Charger ID / Serial No.:
uMzVew
Charger address/functional location: Brazil
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: HMI issue
Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB.
1. Verify if the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is not OK.
2. Verify if the DP cable is properly attached.
If both are OK, then replace the HMI.
I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger:
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1 - Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments wIo AC cutout
8EM5902-1AA02-2AA7 - Controlp. middle segm. with CCR cutout
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 - Controlpanel adaptation set
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-BR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

.
